en.hook: OMAD is not the right starting point for everyone.
en.script: A longer plan is not automatically a better plan. Experience, daily schedule, and individual health matter. Beginners may consider building consistency with a gentler schedule.
en.safety_note: Seek professional guidance for pregnancy, medication use, an eating-disorder history, or a health condition.

tr.hook: 16:8 zor geliyorsa önce bu üç şeyi kontrol et.

en.hook: If 16:8 feels difficult, check these three things first.
en.script: Changing the start time every day, forgetting hydration, and choosing a longer plan to compensate can make consistency harder. Choose a simpler schedule you can repeat.
en.safety_note: End the fast if you feel unwell and seek professional support when needed.

tr.script: Açlık dalgası geldiğinde FastTrack destek modu seni kısa bir duraklamaya çağırır. Nasıl hissettiğini fark et, su durumunu kontrol et ve bilinçli karar ver.

en.script: When a hunger wave arrives, FastTrack support mode creates a short pause. Notice how you feel, check hydration, and make a deliberate decision.
en.safety_note: End the fast and seek help for severe or concerning symptoms.
